name: monoheader
description: A private, local-only HTTP header modification extension for Chrome and Firefox.
author: Monolith Consulting AB

scripts.check: npm run check:chrome && npm run check:firefox
scripts.package:all: npm run icons && node scripts/package.mjs && node scripts/package-firefox.mjs && node scripts/package-source.mjs
scripts.lint:firefox: npm run package:firefox && web-ext lint --source-dir dist/monoheader-firefox --warnings-as-errors
scripts.release:check: npm test && npm run check && npm run lint:firefox && npm run test:e2e && npm run package:all
